question: What initial sequence is prescribed for constructing the Tripureśī mantra?
premises: The name Tripureśī is to be uttered
The heart-word follows at the end of tāra
inference: The mantra begins by uttering Tripureśī and then placing the heart-word after tāra.
uncertainties: Exact referent of tārānte and hṛtpadaṃ depends on transmitted mantra convention
plain_english: Having uttered ‘Tripureśī’, then place the heart-word at the end of the tāra syllable.
